test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following countries is the second largest cotton producer in the world as of October 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is **__India.__**

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Cotton requires high temperature and bright sunshine for its growth.
 
• Among jute, cotton, and hemp, cotton is the most significant fibre crop in the country.
 
• In India, cotton grows in the Deccan region because of the well drier parts of the black cotton soil.
 
• As per the statistics, India was the second-largest producer of cotton after China in 2015.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• China is the leading producer of cotton.
 
• In 2019, India produced 6,423,000 metric tonnes of cotton whereas China produced 5,933,000 metric tonnes of cotton.
 
• However, in 2021-22, China produced 64,23,000 metric tonnes while India produced 61,62,000 metric tonnes of cotton.
 
• The USA is the third largest producer of cotton in the world after India and China.
 
• Bangladesh is in 8th position among cotton-producing countries.
